Risk Register

Risk: Deep discharge damages the pack RISK_DEEP_DISCHARGE
open
Severity: high
mitigated by: SPEC_LOW_THRESHOLD

If the driver gets no warning, the pack can discharge below 10.5 V and lose capacity for good.
Risk: Voltage sensor drift RISK_SENSOR_DRIFT
open
Severity: medium

An aging sensor can read 100 mV high and delay the low warning.
